async def act(page):
    # Check current page title to confirm if on Reports page
    title = await page.title()
    if "Reports" not in title:
        # Click the Reports link in the menubar
        await page.get_by_role("menubar").get_by_role("link", name=" Reports").click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Now on Reports page, look for order-related reports
    # Try to find a link with 'Order' or 'Sales' in the name
    order_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Order", exact=False).first
    if await order_link.is_visible():
        await order_link.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    else:
        sales_link = page.get_by_role("link", name="Sales", exact=False).first
        if await sales_link.is_visible():
            await sales_link.click()
            await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set year filter to 2022 if available
    year_select = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Year", exact=False).first
    if await year_select.is_visible():
        await year_select.select_option("2022")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Set status filter to 'successful' if available
    status_select = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Status", exact=False).first
    if await status_select.is_visible():
        await status_select.select_option("successful")
        await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    # Extract data from table
    table = page.get_by_role("table").first
    if await table.is_visible():
        rows = await table.get_by_role("row").all()
        data = []
        for row in rows:
            cells = await row.get_by_role("cell").all()
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                month = await cells[0].text_content()
                count = await cells[1].text_content()
                data.append(f"{month}:{count}")
        # Print data as-is
        for item in data:
            print(item)
    else:
        print("No table found with order count data.")
